name: Live Server
description: Starts a local server for HTML, PHP and static files in the project folder and reloads the page in the browser as soon as a file changes (CSS without a reload). PHP runs through php -S. Ships with program code.
author: Lumen

settings.label: Port
settings.hint: If it is taken, the server uses the next free one.

settings.label: Address
settings.hint: 127.0.0.1 = this machine only; 0.0.0.0 = the network too (a phone, say).

settings.label: Subfolder
settings.hint: Relative to the project folder. Empty = the project folder itself.

settings.label: Reload automatically
settings.hint: Adds a small script to pages; CSS changes swap the styles only.

settings.label: File types that reload
settings.hint: Comma-separated, without the dot. CSS is always swapped live.

settings.label: Ignored folders
settings.hint: Comma-separated folder names that are not watched.

settings.label: Run PHP
settings.hint: Starts php -S in the project folder when PHP is found.

settings.label: Path to php
settings.hint: Leave empty to use php from the PATH.

commands.title: Live Server: Open active file in browser
Live Server: Open the site in the browser
